description: This is a Makefile for building images and device configurations for embedded devices based on Rockchip SOCs, specifically for ARMv8 architecture. It defines device-specific configurations, load addresses, and dependencies for various devices such as Firefly ROC-RK3328-CC, NanoPi R2C, R2S, R4S, Pine64 RockPro64, Radxa Rock Pi 4A, and Orange Pi R1 Plus models.
